text: Verifies identity documents, phone numbers, name, date of birth, ID numbers, and addresses
quote: Using Identity Verification, you can verify identification documents, phone numbers, name, date of birth, ID numbers, addresses, and more.

text: Lets you combine multiple verification checks into one template and run checks conditionally based on prior results, risk, or user country
quote: You can combine multiple verification checks within a single Identity Verification template via the Workflow Management editor, and even run certain checks conditionally, such as only running a particular verification if another verificatio

text: Emits distinct lifecycle events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) for verification sessions
quote: For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED

text: Sandbox mode accepts fixed test inputs to deterministically produce successful data-source and documentary verification results
quote: In Sandbox mode, Identity Verification accepts the fixed set of inputs below in order to result in successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks.

text: Client-side onEvent callback fires with progress updates throughout the verification flow
quote: onEvent will fire at certain points throughout the IDV flow with updates on the user's progress at each point.

text: Reports a conversion rate metric measuring the percentage of started sessions that were completed
quote: The conversion rate is defined as the percentage of sessions begun that were completed, regardless of whether the user passed or failed verification.

text: Allows reviewers to manually override a failed verification result from the Dashboard
quote: you can override a failure via the Dashboard by clicking the Override Result button on the verification detail page in the Dashboard.

text: Provides a no-code editor for creating and modifying verification workflows
quote: No-code editor to create and change verification flows

text: Integrates with Plaid Monitor to provide end-to-end verification plus ongoing KYC monitoring
quote: Monitor also integrates directly with Identity Verification for an end-to-end verification and KYC solution.

text: Displays granular risk signals (email risk, phone risk, etc.) plus an overall risk score per session in the Dashboard
quote: Identity Verification will also display a set of granular risk assessments (email risk, phone risk, etc.) in the Dashboard for each session, along with an overall risk score

text: Authenticates global government ID documents for authenticity and validity
quote:
Authenticate IDs

Verify that global ID documents are authentic and valid.
